name: mockllm Local LLM API Mock Server
free_limit: MIT-licensed local mock server for LLM provider APIs, with configurable deterministic responses, simulated errors and SSE streaming; no software usage quota or expiration published.
watch_out: Run the Go binary or Docker image on your own computer/CI infrastructure; no hosted LLM inference, model access or compute is included. Generated provider specifications may require updates to match changing APIs; do not expose mock endpoints publicly without access controls.
